status.en: 14 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 48% fewer than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Merti.
status.nb: 14 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 48 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Merti.

summary.en: Ethiopian military drones have entered Sudan while RSF drones are being launched from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting reciprocal diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. In northern Ethiopia, an RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers and a Kenyan, leading Inspector General Douglas Kanja to deploy additional police officers and hold security talks. The conflict has forced over 50,000 Ethiopian refugees to register in Kenya. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske militærdroner har gått inn i Sudan mens RSF-militsens droner blir skutt fra etiopisk territorium mot sudanske mål, noe som har ført til gjensidige diplomatiske utvisninger og konsulære nedleggelser. I Nord-Etiopia drepte et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale 60 etiopiske ortodokse troende og en kenyaner, noe som førte til at inspektørgeneralen Douglas Kanja sendte flere politifolk og holdt sikkerhetsmøter. Konflikten har tvunget over 50 000 etiopiske flyktninger til å registrere seg i Kenya. Krigen forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano Insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
